title: Zeros of complete elliptic integrals and its application to Melnikov functions
summary: In this paper, we first discuss the linear independence of the complete elliptic integrals of the first, second and third kinds $K(k)$, $E(k)$ and $Π(μ(k),k)$, and then obtain an upper bound for the number of zeros of a function of the form \begin{eqnarray*} p(k)K(k)+q(k)E(k)+r(k)Π(μ(k),k),\ k\in(-1,1), \end{eqnarray*} where $p(k)$, $q(k)$ and $r(k)$ are real polynomials, $μ(k)$ is a real polynomial or rational function. Finally, we apply it to a Hamiltonian triangle with three invariant straight lines under small real polynomials piecewise smooth perturbation.
